name: Question 1
problem: Given the function $f(x,y,z)=\frac{{x}^{2}}{2}+{y}^{2}-{z}^{2}$, find the equation of the tangent plane to the level surface that passes through the point where $(x,y,z)=(4,-1,3).$
worked_solution:
The equation of the tangent plane to the level surface $f(x,y,z)=k$ at the point $({x}_{0},{y}_{0},{z}_{0})$ can be expressed as

$$
∇f({x}_{0},{y}_{0},{z}_{0})\cdot ⟨x-{x}_{0},\,y-{y}_{0},\,z-{z}_{0}⟩=0.
$$

First, we find the gradient of $f(x,y,z)$ and evaluate it at $({x}_{0},{y}_{0},{z}_{0})=(4,-1,3):$  

$$
\begin{aligned}∇f(x,y,z) & ={f}_{x}(x,y,z)\,i+{f}_{y}(x,y,z)\,j+{f}_{z}(x,y,z)\,k \\  & =\frac{∂}{∂x}(\frac{{x}^{2}}{2}+{y}^{2}-{z}^{2})i+\frac{∂}{∂y}(\frac{{x}^{2}}{2}+{y}^{2}-{z}^{2})j+\frac{∂}{∂z}(\frac{{x}^{2}}{2}+{y}^{2}-{z}^{2})k \\  & =x\text{ }i+2y\text{ }j-2z\text{ }k \\ ∇f(4,-1,3) & =(4)\text{ }i+2(-1)\text{ }j-2(3)\text{ }k \\  & =4i-2j-6k \\  & =⟨4,\,-2,\,-6⟩\end{aligned}
$$

 

We can now write down the Cartesian equation of the tangent plane to the level surface, as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}∇f({x}_{0},{y}_{0},{z}_{0})\cdot ⟨x-{x}_{0},\,y-{y}_{0},\,z-{z}_{0}⟩ & =0 \\ ∇f(4,-1,3)\cdot ⟨x-4,\,y-(-1),\,z-3⟩ & =0 \\ ⟨4,\,-2,\,-6⟩\cdot ⟨x-4,\,y+1,\,z-3⟩ & =0 \\ 4(x-4)-2(y+1)-6(z-3) & =0 \\ 4x-2y-6z & =0 \\ 2x-y-3z & =0\end{aligned}
$$

Question 1
?

Given the function f(x,y,z)=x22+y2−z2, find the equation of the tangent plane to the level surface that passes through the point where (x,y,z)=(4,−1,3).

a
x+2y−6z=0
b
2x−y−3z=0
c
x−2y+3z−15=0
d
x+2y−6z+14=0
e
x−y−3z+5=0
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

The equation of the tangent plane to the level surface f(x,y,z)=k at the point (x0,y0,z0) can be expressed as

∇f(x0,y0,z0)⋅⟨x−x0,y−y0,z−z0⟩=0.

First, we find the gradient of f(x,y,z) and evaluate it at (x0,y0,z0)=(4,−1,3):

∇f(x,y,z)=fx(x,y,z)i+fy(x,y,z)j+fz(x,y,z)k=∂∂x(x22+y2−z2)i+∂∂y(x22+y2−z2)j+∂∂z(x22+y2−z2)k=x i+2y j−2z k∇f(4,−1,3)=(4) i+2(−1) j−2(3) k=4i−2j−6k=⟨4,−2,−6⟩

We can now write down the Cartesian equation of the tangent plane to the level surface, as follows:

∇f(x0,y0,z0)⋅⟨x−x0,y−y0,z−z0⟩=0∇f(4,−1,3)⋅⟨x−4,y−(−1),z−3⟩=0⟨4,−2,−6⟩⋅⟨x−4,y+1,z−3⟩=04(x−4)−2(y+1)−6(z−3)=04x−2y−6z=02x−y−3z=0
